tools.name: search_objects
tools.description: Search across tasks, projects, portfolios, goals, teams, users, tags, custom fields and AI Teammates. Useful when you do not know an object's GID.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Return full details for one task, including subtasks, comments and dependencies.

tools.name: get_tasks
tools.description: List tasks filtered by project, section, tag, user task list or assignee. At least one filter is required.

tools.name: get_my_tasks
tools.description: List tasks assigned to the authenticated user, with optional completion filtering.

tools.name: search_tasks
tools.description: Advanced task search across names, descriptions and comments with multiple filters. Premium accounts only.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Return details for one project, optionally including its sections.

tools.name: get_projects
tools.description: List projects, optionally by team or including archived ones.

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.description: Return details for one portfolio and its projects.

tools.name: get_portfolios
tools.description: List portfolios owned by the authenticated user in the current workspace.

tools.name: get_items_for_portfolio
tools.description: List the projects and goals inside a portfolio.

tools.name: get_status_overview
tools.description: Build an aggregated status report for projects or portfolios matched by keyword.

tools.name: get_attachments
tools.description: List attachments for a task, project or project brief.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Return a user by GID, email or "me".

tools.name: get_me
tools.description: Return the authenticated user's name, email and workspace memberships.

tools.name: get_users
tools.description: List workspace users, optionally filtered by team, with pagination.

tools.name: get_teams
tools.description: List workspace teams, optionally filtered to a specific user's teams.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Return the full record for one AI Teammate by GID.

tools.name: get_workspace_agents
tools.description: List AI Teammates in the workspace, with pagination.

tools.name: create_tasks
tools.description: Create up to 50 tasks per call immediately, with no confirmation step.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a project immediately, optionally with sections and tasks.

tools.name: update_tasks
tools.description: Update up to 50 tasks per call: name, assignee, dates, completion and more.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Permanently delete a task and its subtasks that are not in other projects. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Add a plain text or HTML comment to a task, including @-mentions and pinned comments.

tools.name: create_project_status_update
tools.description: Post a status update to a project or portfolio with a color and body text.

tools.name: create_task_preview
tools.description: Draft a single task for review before creating it.

tools.name: create_project_preview
tools.description: Draft a full project plan with sections, tasks and assignees for review before creating it.

tools.name: search_tasks_preview
tools.description: Search tasks and show results in an interactive UI.
